concept: A calm celestial harvest atelier shaped by care, craft, and ordered natural forms.
floor: One continuous smooth wheat-cream cork floor across the full top face, with broad sage shading and no fibers, grain specks, grass, tiles, symbols, rings, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: One elegant leaf-and-grain-inspired workshop arch at the rear made from a few oversized sage and ivory forms around a blank pale-teal astrolabe disc.
rear_props: two broad orderly herb planters with one large leaf mass each
side_props: one large sage cabinet and cream workbench on the upper-left edge
two oversized wheat-gold leaf sculptures on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous rounded sage wall with broad ivory cap blocks

lighting: soft clear morning light with restrained warm atelier glow
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open cork floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, person, maiden, animal, egg, or familiar baked into the bitmap
zodiac glyph, constellation, readable chart, text, center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, watermark, external shadow, tiny herbs, grain specks, cracks, or dense clutter
